en.help.intro.architecture: Built with Tauri 2.x (Rust) for the native shell, React 19 for the UI, and a Node.js sidecar for media orchestration. SQLite stores all metadata locally.
en.help.intro.features.offline: Fully offline processing — no internet required
en.help.intro.features.vmaf: Active VMAF quality scoring with per-profile thresholds
en.help.metrics.lufs: LUFS (Loudness Units Full Scale) measures audio loudness. Target: -23 LUFS for broadcast, -14 LUFS for web/social.
en.help.metrics.lufsDescription: Integrated loudness measure according to EBU R128 standard. The standard target for European broadcast is −23 LUFS ±1 LU. For streaming (Spotify, YouTube) the target is typically −14 LUFS.
en.help.metrics.networkDesc: Network ↓↑ — aggregated download and upload throughput of all interfaces
en.help.metrics.ramDesc: RAM — memory used / total in GB
en.help.metrics.realtime: Real-time metrics update every 2 seconds during active jobs.
en.help.metrics.title: Quality metrics
en.help.metrics.truePeak: True Peak (dBTP) prevents digital clipping. Limit: -1 dBTP for all profiles.
en.help.metrics.vmaf: VMAF (Video Multi-Method Assessment Fusion) scores perceptual quality from 0-100. Thresholds: 85 (web), 90 (broadcast SD), 93 (broadcast HD/4K).
en.help.metrics.vmafDescription: Perceptual video quality metric developed by Netflix. Simulates human perception by comparing the processed video with the original.

en.help.screens.cloud.dropbox.desc: Use your own Dropbox App Key to connect. Create a Dropbox app at developers.dropbox.com, then enter the App Key in the profile. Nexora uses PKCE flow — your App Secret is never stored.
en.help.screens.cloud.dropbox.step1: Go to developers.dropbox.com → Create App → Scoped Access → Full Dropbox
en.help.screens.cloud.dropbox.step2: Copy the App Key and enter it in the Dropbox profile form
en.help.screens.cloud.dropbox.step3: Click 'Authenticate' — a browser window opens to authorize. The token is stored in the OS keychain.
en.help.screens.cloud.dropbox.title: Dropbox — PKCE OAuth
en.help.screens.cloud.gdrivePersonal.desc: Use your own Google Cloud Console credentials (Client ID + Client Secret). This gives you full control over the OAuth app that accesses your Drive. Nexora uses PKCE flow — no client secret is stored on disk.
en.help.screens.cloud.gdrivePersonal.step1: Create an OAuth 2.0 Client ID in Google Cloud Console (type: Desktop App)
en.help.screens.cloud.gdrivePersonal.step2: Enter the Client ID and Client Secret in the profile form, then click 'Authenticate'
en.help.screens.cloud.gdrivePersonal.step3: A browser window opens — log in and authorize. The token is saved in the OS keychain.
en.help.screens.cloud.gdrivePersonal.title: Google Drive Personal — PKCE OAuth
en.help.screens.cloud.mega.desc: Connect with your MEGA email and password. Files are always end-to-end encrypted by MEGA — Nexora never sends data in plaintext to MEGA servers. The destination folder must exist in your MEGA account before testing.
en.help.screens.cloud.mega.tip1: Create the destination folder in mega.nz first (e.g. Nexora/Output inside Cloud Drive).
en.help.screens.cloud.mega.tip2: Enter the folder path without a leading slash: Nexora/Output
en.help.screens.cloud.mega.tip3: Login is performed fresh per operation — no session is cached locally.
en.help.screens.cloud.mega.title: MEGA — End-to-End Encrypted Cloud
en.help.screens.cloud.sftp.desc: Connect to any SFTP server with username/password or SSH key authentication. Fill in Host, Port (default 22), Username, Password or key path, and the remote base folder.
en.help.screens.cloud.sftp.tip1: Port 22 is the standard SFTP port — change only if your server uses a custom port.
en.help.screens.cloud.sftp.tip2: Password auth and key-based auth are both supported.
en.help.screens.cloud.sftp.tip3: Use 'Test Connection' to verify the server is reachable and the credentials are valid before saving.
en.help.screens.cloud.sftp.title: SFTP — SSH File Transfer
en.help.screens.cloud.smb.desc: Connect to Windows shares and NAS devices using SMB/CIFS. Enter the share path (e.g. \\server\share), username, and password. Leave username/password empty for guest access.
en.help.screens.cloud.smb.tip2: Domain accounts: enter username as DOMAIN\user.
en.help.screens.cloud.smb.tip3: SMB paths containing '..' are blocked for security (path traversal prevention).
en.help.screens.cloud.smb.title: SMB / Windows Share
en.help.support.factoryResetDescription: If the app shows inconsistent behavior, data that won't clear, or database errors, you can perform a Total Reset in Settings → Advanced.
en.help.support.factoryResetWarning: This will delete ALL data, settings, and history. The app will restart. This action cannot be undone.
en.help.support.problem1Desc: Check if FFmpeg is correctly detected in the System tab.
en.help.support.problem2Desc: Make sure Nexora has write permissions to the configured folder.
en.help.support.problems.1: No GPU detected — Install latest graphics drivers
en.help.support.problems.2: Jobs failing at transcode — Verify FFmpeg binary is bundled
en.help.system.stackFrontend: Frontend: React 19 + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS 4 + Zustand
en.help.usage.step1Desc: Click the rocket icon in the navigation bar to access the processing page.
en.help.usage.step2Desc: Drag an MP4, MXF, MOV or any FFmpeg-supported format to the drop zone. You can also click to open the file picker.
en.help.usage.step3Desc: Choose the profile appropriate for the final destination (broadcast, web, social). Each profile has pre-configured parameters for compliance and optimal quality.
en.help.usage.step4Desc: Click Process. The job is added to the queue and processed in the background. The app remains responsive during processing.
en.help.usage.step5Desc: The Dashboard shows active jobs, average VMAF score and disk space. The progress bar updates in real time.
en.help.usage.step6Desc: After completion, the asset appears in History with codec, duration, size and VMAF score. Use the details button to see all metadata.
en.help.usage.steps.1: Add media via drag & drop or file dialog
en.help.usage.steps.2: Select a transcode profile (broadcast-hd, web-4k, etc.)
en.help.usage.steps.3: Submit to the queue — jobs process automatically
en.help.usage.steps.4: Review QC reports and approve/reject quarantined items
en.help.usage.steps.5: Access processed files in the output folder
en.help.usage.tip1: Enable GPU in Settings for 5-10x faster transcoding
en.help.usage.tip2: The Proxy profile is ideal for creating editing versions — never for final delivery
en.help.usage.tip3: Save logs in Settings → Logs for troubleshooting
en.help.usage.tip4: The output directory can be set globally or per profile in Settings
en.help.usage.tipsList.1: Use GPU acceleration for 5-10x faster transcodes
en.help.usage.tipsList.2: Enable notifications to get alerts when jobs finish
en.help.usage.tipsList.3: Check the Logs page for detailed FFmpeg output
en.help.usage.tipsList.4: Factory Reset wipes everything — use with caution
